create or replace function public.segments_guard_update()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
begin
  if auth.role() = 'service_role' then
    return new;
  end if;

  if tg_op = 'UPDATE' then
    if new.id is distinct from old.id
       or new.project_id is distinct from old.project_id
       or new.lang is distinct from old.lang
       or new.source_text is distinct from old.source_text
       or new.status not in ('draft', 'reviewed')
       or new.status = 'draft'
          and old.status = 'reviewed'
       or new.status = 'reviewed'
          and old.status = 'draft'
          and auth.role() = 'authenticated'
          and not exists (
            select 1
            from public.translators t
            where t.project_id = new.project_id
              and t.user_id = auth.uid()
              and t.lang = new.lang
              and t.role = 'reviewer'
          ) then
      raise exception 'Invalid segment update';
    end if;

    if new.status = 'draft'
       and auth.role() = 'authenticated'
       and exists (
         select 1
         from public.translators t
         where t.project_id = new.project_id
           and t.user_id = auth.uid()
           and t.lang = new.lang
       ) then
      if new.translated_by is distinct from auth.uid() then
        raise exception 'translated_by must be the current user';
      end if;
    elsif new.status = 'reviewed'
           and auth.role() = 'authenticated'
           and exists (
             select 1
             from public.translators t
             where t.project_id = new.project_id
               and t.user_id = auth.uid()
               and t.lang = new.lang
               and t.role = 'reviewer'
           ) then
      if new.translated_by is distinct from auth.uid() then
        raise exception 'translated_by must be the current user';
      end if;
    else
      raise exception 'Invalid segment status transition';
    end if;
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.sign_envelope(p_envelope_id bigint)
returns text
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_status text;
begin
  update public.envelopes
  set status = 'completed'
  where id = p_envelope_id
    and status = 'sent'
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.envelope_recipients er
      where er.envelope_id = p_envelope_id
        and er.user_id = auth.uid()
    )
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.envelope_recipients er
      where er.envelope_id = p_envelope_id
        and er.signed_at is null
        and er.sign_order < (
          select er2.sign_order
          from public.envelope_recipients er2
          where er2.envelope_id = p_envelope_id
            and er2.user_id = auth.uid()
        )
    );

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Not allowed to sign this envelope';
  end if;

  update public.envelope_recipients
  set signed_at = now()
  where envelope_id = p_envelope_id
    and user_id = auth.uid()
    and signed_at is null;

  select status into v_status
  from public.envelopes
  where id = p_envelope_id;

  return v_status;
end
$$;
